reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many downstream services including adservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, and shippingservice.
All these downstream services have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow internally but requests queue before frontend processes them.
Frontend CPU usage is at 79% of its very low 10m CPU limit, confirming CPU throttling and resource exhaustion at frontend.
Adservice shows some errors but only from one caller (frontend), and its errors are likely a symptom of frontend delays, not a separate fault.
Frontend pod was recreated 331s ago due to a CPU limit change from 200m to 10m, which likely caused the resource exhaustion and latency increase.
Therefore, frontend is the root cause with resource_exhaustion fault type, propagating latency to all downstream services on the critical path and others.
